verdict.rationale: Calendar sync is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack never documents syncing a user's calendar so that meetings appear on contact or deal timelines. The only calendar-related item is a one-way subscription that shows Capsule tasks on a personal calendar. That is an adjacent outbound feature, not an inbound meeting sync. Mailbox connection and the Gmail and Outlook add-ins cover email, not calendar events.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines
